frontend.des:
Frontend developer with 1.5 years of experience in creating
responsive, user-friendly applications using HTML, CSS,
JavaScript, React, and TypeScript technologies. Experienced in
Redux Toolkit, Zustand and Tailwind CSS. Proficient in crafting
reusable UI components, integrating RESTful APIs, and optimizing
performance through lazy loading, code splitting, and efficient
API calls — achieving up to 20% improvement in load times. Strong
grasp of version control (Git), modern build tools (Vite,
Webpack). Skilled in writing clean and efficient code. I’m
dedicated to ongoing self-improvement and consistently seek out
new tools and technologies to expand my knowledge.
